decisions.reason: As a young product that fits the firm's modular environmental-technology direction, it is likely to be retained for further market learning despite some risk of consolidation because its website prominence is limited and a similar flagship line exists.
This shredder sits close to the core range and was given its own page, so its expected performance is more likely to meet aspiration levels or justify continued support while sales accumulate.

Because it is a flagship multi-model line aligned with the firm's stated future strategy, management would likely use organisational slack to continue backing it even if early results were still uncertain.

The trommel screen is adjacent to the established business and supports the firm's system-selling and after-sales model, so absent clear underperformance it would usually be kept, though with less strategic protection than the flagship line.
